widescreen.description: Fill the screen with a moving camera view. Right stick / mouse wheel: look up/down.
aspectlimit.description: Set the widest aspect used by widescreen. 16:9 is the default; narrower screens adapt.
wobble.description: Stabilize character and object geometry. Reduces the original polygon wobble.
controltype.description: Original: turn and move relative to the player. Alternate: move in the direction you press.
bindings.description: Remaster: WASD and HD Remaster buttons. Original: use the native custom bindings.
defaultpace.description: Choose whether you normally walk or run. Applies to alternate keyboard controls.
shiftbehavior.description: Hold Shift, or press it to switch pace. Applies to alternate keyboard controls.
mousesteering.description: Turn while standing, walking or running. While aiming, also aim up/down with the mouse.
mousesensitivity.description: Adjust mouse turning and vertical aim response. Only affects mouse steering.
autopush.description: Push objects without releasing the run button. Applies to alternate movement controls.
skipintro.description: Go straight to the title menu on startup. Story movies are still played.
skipdoors.description: Skip door animations between rooms. The next room still loads normally.
fastload.description: Skip the recap text after loading a save. Story dialogue is unaffected.
autoload.description: Load the selected save when the game starts. If unavailable, show the save selection.
loadslot.description: Choose the save used by Load game and Auto load. Latest selects the most recently saved file.
portable.description: Save native settings beside the game. Restart the game to apply this change.
overlayhotkey.description: Opens the in-game settings overlay (Ctrl held with the key). Back + Start on a controller also opens it.
textlanguage.description: Language of the settings overlay. Auto follows the game's language.
